title: Primarina-Ping, Aqua Ping and Odette Ping playing in the sea
prompt:
Create ONE finished portrait-oriented PRINTABLE COLORING BOOK COMIC PAGE, approximately A4 aspect ratio, with EXACTLY FOUR rectangular panels in a clean 2 by 2 grid. Thick simple black panel borders, generous white gutters, and a white outer print margin. NO TEXT: no captions, words, letters, numbers, title, speech bubbles, sound effects, logo or watermark.

Use the THREE reference characters throughout:
1 PRIMARINA-PING from image 1: huge rounded head, swept forelock, long curled high ponytail with large pearl beads, star hair ornament, fin crest, scalloped collar, tiny flipper arms, curved mermaid tail and fan tail fin.
2 AQUA PING from image 2: huge fox-like head, two tall upright fox ears, short wavy forelock, flared cheek gill fans, little muzzle, short flipper arms, mermaid tail with dorsal fins and two-lobed fluke.
3 ODETTE PING from image 3: huge rounded head and tiny childlike body, straight shoulder-length hair with wispy fringe and small side barrette, large expressive eyes, little heart-dot nose. Her established hair is brown and eyes blue, but render them as WHITE outlined shapes for coloring, no filled color or black hair. Dress her in a simple modest one-piece swimsuit with a small heart motif. Odette has TWO HUMAN LEGS AND FEET, not a mermaid tail. Exactly two arms. Keep her recognizable facial likeness and haircut.
All three have cheerful friendly expressions and their consistent distinctive designs from the references. Convert the reference 3D designs into slightly simplified 2D BLACK LINE ART.

A playful wordless sea adventure, with ALL THREE characters clearly visible in EACH panel:
TOP LEFT: At the sea surface, Odette swims in the middle between Primarina and Aqua while they playfully splash each other, several large outlined droplets, gentle wave curves and one simple cloud.
TOP RIGHT: Underwater, all three swim together through several big bubbles. Primarina blows a bubble, Aqua taps one, and Odette swims between them reaching toward a bubble with a happy expression. Her two little legs kick behind her. Two tiny simple fish in background.
BOTTOM LEFT: At the surface, the three friends play catch with a large striped beach ball. Odette pushes the ball toward Aqua, Primarina cheers beside them, simple wave shapes.
BOTTOM RIGHT: In shallow clear sea water, the three friends build a small sandcastle together on the seabed. Odette places a big shell on top, Primarina pats a turret, Aqua brings a shell. A few large simple shells and two sparse seaweed fronds complete the scene.

COLORING BOOK REQUIREMENTS: pure BLACK outlines on a pure opaque WHITE background. Absolutely NO COLOR, no gray shading, no gradients, no hatching, no stippling, no textures or shadows. No large solid black regions. Hair, eyes, swimsuit, tails and sea all stay white inside clean closed outlines, ready to color. Large outlined iris circles with small outlined highlights; avoid solid black disc eyes. Medium-bold smooth outer contours and minimal thinner interior lines. Large open coloring areas, simple hair locks, 4-5 pearls rather than dense beads, uncluttered backgrounds. Professional crisp clean line art, not rough sketch. Exactly 3 main characters per panel, no duplicate faces, no merged bodies, coherent arms and tails, no cropping of ears or hair at panel borders. Keep each character large enough to color comfortably. Single complete page, four panels only.
